_comment: Curated corrections to the GeoNames city dump (prisma/data/cities.json), which is regenerated by scripts/migrate-to-geonames.ts and so cannot be edited in place. Applied by scripts/build-map-regions.ts when building the map and by scripts/apply-city-overrides.ts when syncing the database.
_renameComment: Northern Cyprus settlements carry their Greek names in GeoNames. The map now draws the KKTC districts from OSM, whose names are Turkish, so the cities they resolve to have to match — otherwise the İskele district would be labelled 'Rizokarpaso', its largest village, rather than its seat. The former name is kept as a search alias.
_addComment: GeoNames has one 'Nicosia' for the whole divided city, and it sits south of the Green Line. The northern half is a separate city with its own municipality, so it needs its own record. Coordinates are the Sarayönü / Atatürk Meydanı area; population is the 2011 KKTC census figure for the Lefkoşa Türk Belediyesi and only affects label priority.
